thread:
Ava (growth): Quick sync — pricing page experiment goes live tomorrow 9:00am PT. Need final QA on FAQ copy, tier names, calculator defaults, inbound lead routing, and the webinar CTA. Who can own what? :eyes:
Miguel (product): I can take FAQ + tier names. Updated the tier names doc yesterday, went more outcome-focused (Starter / Scale / Enterprise -> Launch / Scale / Committed). Want to avoid legal-y language.
Priya (content): Saw that — prefer 'Launch' -> 'Scale' -> 'Committed' but can we test microcopy alternatives on the hero CTA: 'Estimate cost' vs 'Try the estimator'?
Jordan (sales): For Enterprise (Committed) we need a clear CTA for 'Contact sales' and a routing tag so leads hit the outbound queue. Put me as the owner if it's high-intent.
Sam (analytics): I'll validate calculator defaults and funnel tagging. Current default assumptions: `monthly_usage = 100k tokens`, `model_tier = optimized-4`, `cache = on`. We'll instrument `utm_experiment=pricing_v7` and add `lead_score` param for inbound.
Nora (dev): The calculator code is ready in `pricing-widget` branch. Quick note — default slider max currently 1_000_000 tokens (might skew average). If Sam wants to change, we can patch before deploy. Build will go out with the page deploy at 08:45 PT.
Ava (growth): Jordan — can you confirm inbound lead routing? We want immediate webhook to SalesOps + CRM tag `pricing_v7_enterprise`.
Jordan (sales): Confirmed. SalesOps webhook + Slack channel #sales-inbound will get `enterprise-pricing` alerts. Also asked to include account size + top-3 feature interest in payload.
Priya (content): FAQ edits: trimmed Q2 about SLA to one sentence and added link to Dedicated docs. Added an accordion note about 'Private deployments' differences. Posting copy here for a quick read: "We offer hosted, dedicated, and private deployments — choose based on latency, compliance, and cost. See Dedicated vs Private -> /docs/deployments"
Miguel (product): Legal flagged 'Committed' wording, wants 'Committed (contracted capacity)' in parentheses on hover. Priya — can you add hover text?
Priya (content): Yep — adding hover microcopy now. Will push to staging.
Sam (analytics): One more: we'll A/B test two calculator defaults — `monthly=50k` vs `100k` — and measure click-to-contact conversion for Enterprise. I added tracking map and dashboard tile.
Nora (dev): Patch ready. I can flip the A/B flag via the feature toggle service. Will also add the `lead_score` payload field Jordan requested.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Pricing launch post + webinar teaser" — Thu 10/12 11:00am PT. Invite sent to marketing, product, sales.
Ava (growth): Perfect. Owners recap: Miguel = FAQ & tier names, Priya = microcopy & FAQ edits, Jordan = inbound routing, Sam = tracking & analysis, Nora = calculator patch + toggle. I'll run the publish checklist at 08:30 PT and post the launch thread. Anything blocking? :thumbsup:
Jordan (sales): No blockers from sales. :thumbsup:
Miguel (product): Legal will confirm hover copy by 07:30 PT.
Priya (content): Staging link: https://staging.redwood.ai/pricing_v7 — please QA copy and accordion behavior.
Sam (analytics): Dashboard preview: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/price_v7 — will finalize tiles after deploy.
Ava (growth): Great — if no objections, we'll ship at 08:45 PT and announce on blog + product Twitter after 09:15. I'll follow up with the launch post draft in this thread in the next 30m. :rocket:
